name: Cancelling the logout confirmation keeps the session
title: SC-06-04-06 Cancelling the logout confirmation keeps the session
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the home owner is signed in
When the home owner opens logout and cancels the confirmation
Then the session is kept
